notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six other creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
description:
Declare Radha, Hellkite Charger and at least six other creatures as attackers.
Radha and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Radha trigger, adding at least {6}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
